name: Mira
greeting: I would like a life with you in it. But not one where we call a dangerous secret kindness because it keeps our supper quiet.
lines: Kael: You kept a secret to keep people alive.
Mira: I did. And I have to answer for it. Privacy is not a licence to let the next household suffer.
Mira: An answer. If we disagree, say so. The medicines are still here either way.

actions.label: No comfort bought by making someone else carry the danger.

relationship_event.text: Kael agreed that a shared life cannot rest on passing a concealed danger to others.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I heard your answer. I will have to live by it as well.

actions.label: Sometimes keeping a dangerous truth quiet is the only mercy left.

relationship_event.text: Mira declined commitment while Kael defended concealing risks. An apology alone does not settle the disagreement.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I care about you. I still cannot build a home on that answer.

actions.label: Let us keep the friendship, without a promise of more.

relationship_event.text: Kael and Mira kept their friendship without entering a romantic commitment.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: A friend can disagree with me. You haven't lost your place here.
